summary: An owner offered a ready replacement has to compare it with the product that broke.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025), section 5. Washington exempted a manufacturer that provides a replacement meeting three conditions. The owner can get it readily, it matches or improves on the original, and the owner pays nothing.
inGame: needs: the manufacturer invokes the free-replacement exception.
gates: The manufacturer invokes the free-replacement exception.

turns.what: The replacement falls short of the original.
turns.pulledBy: The replacement lacks a feature the owner needs and the original had.

turns.what: The owner takes an equivalent replacement home.
turns.pulledBy: The maker has an equivalent unit ready and provides it to the owner at no charge.
turns.writesBack: The owner has a working device and the replacement is recorded as supplied.
